hardware.metadata_has_burst_resolution: Isolated platform build changes all three HAS_BURST values to 1; original release RTL/ZIP unchanged
hardware.platform_artifacts: See hash-verified f8_runtime_bundle_v1 manifest; never use the old C3 dynamic-IP artifacts

done_semantics: read does not clear; write CONTINUE then observe done=0 and idle=1

host.alignment_scope: conservative host restriction, not a characterized hardware minimum
host.aliasing: reject overlapping allocation ranges for any pair
host.concurrency: one exclusive runtime/CU owner, one outstanding task, concurrent calls rejected
host.runtime_route: XRT 2.18 native xrt::ip + xrt::bo persistent owner; Python Unix socket client; metadata-only xclbin
host.timeout_policy: latch FAULT; persistent native process retains runtime/BOs across client exit; reject new work until explicit verified recovery
host.recovery: RECOVER requires hardware idle, auto_restart=0, zero outstanding AXI and bus quiet; completed task acknowledged with Continue. Permanent stalls remain quarantined; no reset/isolation recovery implemented
host.guard_scope: 0x5a tail to allocation end and input immutability; no leading guard at offset=0

platform_status.unrecoverable_fault_policy: retain native owner and BOs; do not kill, unload overlay or reprogram while traffic is unresolved

validation.status_scope: Pre-board packaging snapshot; dated board result records report subsequent actual execution without mutating this immutable bundle
validation.development_tests: tests/test_f8_host.py and tests/test_f8_runtime.py; see timestamped results for actual status
validation.build_origin: original author 2026.1 IP RTL; new isolated Vivado 2020.2.2 PS/AXI/DDR/status platform; build and board gates recorded separately
